posts.text: Best of ETfs and Smallcases — Interesting idea, and thanks for sharing it. There are a few practical challenges with such a model. ETFs are regulated products and can only be launched by an AMC under the applicable regulatory framework. Additionally, if individuals are effectively creating investment products or soliciting investments based on their recommendations, there are regulatory considerations around who can provide such services.
